action_items: Verify backend computation of kpis.avg_coverage in /api/dashboard/skills-map-v2 — currently returning 0 which renders as 0% on UI (probably correct given 27 critical gaps, but worth double-checking).

critical_code_review_comments: CareerDevPage.jsx is ~470 lines with multiple inline components (CareerLadder, CareerPathBrowser). Consider extracting into separate files under /components/career/ for maintainability.
CareerDevPage line 304: `catch (_) { /* silenced */ }` in generatePlan silently swallows errors; user will see infinite loading or empty state if AI call fails. Surface a toast/error UI.
SkillsMapV2Page.jsx renders 175 skill rows in DOM when expand-all is used — acceptable now but worth virtualization if data grows.
All required data-testids are present and well-named — excellent for automation.
